Join molecule_hierarchy from parent CHEMBL2403108 to include parent and all salts. Join compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Join compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary for activity provenance. Filter for target CHEMBL4247 and IC50 bioactivities with nM units. Return all matching rows without limit.
